findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_guard_verdict, search, fetch, emem_echo_verify · Private data: emem_entity, emem_memory_token, emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_echo_verify, emem_entity_resolve, emem_entity_link · Public sink: emem_locate, emem_memory_token, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_ask, emem_intent · Destructive: emem_guard_verdict.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_guard_verdict, search, fetch, emem_echo_verify · Private data: emem_entity, emem_memory_token, emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_echo_verify, emem_entity_resolve, emem_entity_link · Public sink: emem_locate, emem_memory_token, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_ask, emem_intent · Destructive: emem_guard_verdict

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
